hypotheses.F0_exact_edge_recomposition: Per-position program edges sum to the frozen three-head state with maximum coordinate error at most 1e-3.
hypotheses.F1_frozen_routes_transport_new_values: Discovery-mean route coefficients applied to held-out native values reach program-output fidelity at least 0.70 in at least three of four direct-read families.
hypotheses.F2_heldout_values_are_necessary_for_iden: Across IOI, capital recall, and repeated retrieval, frozen routes with held-out values exceed native routes with frozen discovery-mean values by at least 0.20 mean program-output fidelity.
hypotheses.F3_value_only_change_is_sufficient: Using one discovery-mean route for both worlds is within 0.10 mean fidelity of separate frozen base/source routes.
hypotheses.F4_actual_edited_edges_recover_the_progr: Native edges at the actual edited positions reach program-output fidelity at least 0.80 in at least three families.
hypotheses.F5_head_typed_routes_beat_permuted_route: Frozen native route coefficients exceed head-permuted route controls by at least 0.10 mean program-output fidelity.
